occurrences.subject: German Bundeswehr new naval port in Emden

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Boris Pistorius on the strategic rationale for a second North Sea naval port
occurrences.quote_span: Pistorius said there was a strategic advantage to a second naval port on the North Sea: "This makes us harder to predict in an emergency and expands our operational capabilities."

occurrences.checkable_against: Official statement by Boris Pistorius and Bundeswehr historical navy personnel and fleet records

occurrences.speaker: Boris Pistorius
occurrences.subject: German Bundeswehr new naval port in Emden

occurrences.checkable_against: Interview statement by Johannes Peters about Emden naval-port suitability
occurrences.quote_span: "Emden offers the opportunity to build a dedicated naval port that complies with the latest requirements, including those for security and port protection," Peters emphasizes in an interview with DW.
occurrences.speaker: Johannes Peters
occurrences.subject: German Bundeswehr new naval port in Emden

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Boris Pistorius on the rationale for selecting Emden

occurrences.subject: German Bundeswehr new naval port in Emden
